invariants.rationale: The method uses the font parameter to draw text; it must not be null for correct operation.
The batch parameter is used for rendering and should not be null for drawing to succeed.
A negative maxWidth may not make sense when rendering text; it is likely intended to describe an allowable drawing width.
Text drawing coordinates are often non-negative, representing screen or widget coordinates.
Screen coordinate systems are typically non-negative in graphics frameworks like libGDX.
